item.title: Indiana QB Fernando Mendoza wins Maxwell and O’Brien awards with Heisman on deck
item.description: Indiana quarterback Fernando Mendoza has won the Maxwell and Davey O’Brien awards on the eve of the Heisman Trophy presentation, and the redshirt junior is heavily favored to take the top prize in college football. item.title: 12 teams, 11 games, one champion: A guide to the College Football Playoff
item.description: The 12-team College Football Playoff bracket is set, and the games begin on Dec. 19. The first round is hosted by the higher seed before the games shift to neutral sites. item.title: Face-covered suspect sought after bold robbery at Augusta Dollar General
item.description: The Richmond County Sheriff’s Office is searching for a suspect accused of robbing the Dollar General at 2549 Deans Bridge Road on Thursday evening. Investigators say the individual, described as approximately 5’11’’ to 6’02’’ and 180–200 pounds, entered the store wearing a face covering and committed an armed robbery before fleeing the area on foot […] The post Face-covered suspect sought after bold robbery at Augusta Dollar General appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Fulton prosecutor to testify about Trump case, despite effort to fight subpoena
item.description: The Georgia Supreme Court heard oral argument Tuesday in a dispute over the extent of the Georgia General Assembly’s authority to compel testimony, but the case may become irrelevant next week now that Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis has agreed to testify. The post Fulton prosecutor to testify about Trump case, despite effort to fight subpoena appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: 3D-printed tool speeds up tank waste sampling at Savannah River Site
item.description: Engineers at the Savannah River Site have developed a 3D-printed tool that could shorten the tank waste sampling process by several months, according to Savannah River Mission Completion. item.title: Attorney says key fentanyl evidence never shared in case of former RCSO deputy
item.description: The defense attorney for former Richmond County Deputy Demondre Mahoney says investigators claimed a field test showed fentanyl inside the county jail but never turned that test over to the defense, even as Mahoney was denied bond and jailed for months before the substance was later confirmed to be baby powder. The post Attorney says key fentanyl evidence never shared in case of former RCSO deputy appeared first on The Augusta Press.
